levels.surface: زياد بن سعد بن ضميرة السلمي

notes: Two «ح»-branches with their own names: two groups, null tail. The first ends at Ziyad b. Dumayra al-Dumri, the second runs to «عن أبيه».
«- قال موسى - وجده» is Musa's variant wording («وجده»): left out, a remark that adds a link to one version only, not a route here.
«وكانا شهدا مع رسول الله» is a story remark: left out. The Companion in the saying is not named in the text.
